d: Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.
The British School of Bahrain (BSB) is an international school in the Kingdom of Bahrain, offering a British education within a diverse, multicultural community.

We are a selective, co-educational, independent school for students aged 3–18. Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum for England and Wales, adapted to reflect the local context, and offers IGCSE, A-Level and BTEC qualifications. Alongside a strong focus on academic achievement, BSB places great importance on pastoral care, individual development and co-curricular opportunities, within a supportive and welcoming environment that maintains a genuine sense of fun.
We are currently welcoming expressions of interest from Teachers of Science for an August 2027 start.

r: Creating Engaging Lessons: Plan and deliver lessons that inspire and challenge all students and are in line with the school's curriculum, policies, and external assessment requirements. You will individualise and differentiate learning, ensuring each student is stretched, supported, and makes outstanding progress.

Supporting and Assessing Progress: Regularly assess students' in-class and at-home learning, providing targeted feedback to drive progress and ensure all students are challenged and supported in reaching their potential.

Building a Positive Learning Environment: Establish a classroom and school environment where students are invested in each other's flourishing, feel valued and supported, and are ready to take risks in their learning.

Collaborating and Sharing Best Practices: Work closely with colleagues as an active member of our learning community, sharing best practices, collaborating with colleagues, and dedicating yourself to your own professional development to ensure the highest standard of education for our students.

Contributing to School Life: Play an active role in the school's co-curricular programme, helping to create a well-rounded, enriching educational experience. From leading clubs to contributing to whole school initiatives, you will help shape the broader life of the school.

Collaborating with Parents: Maintain open and constructive communication with parents, building strong partnerships that support students' progress so that each child feels like an individual, well-known and respected.

d: We are seeking an experienced Principal Mechanical Engineer to lead the delivery of complex infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on gas systems (LPG, SNG and Natural Gas networks), district cooling/chilled water networks, pump stations, and utility infrastructure. The role will be responsible for providing technical leadership, delivering engineering solutions, securing authority approvals, managing multidisciplinary coordination, and ensuring high-quality project delivery in accordance with local regulations and international standards.

The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert, mentor engineering teams, engage directly with clients and authorities, and contribute to the growth and technical excellence of the Infrastructure Business.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized university.
Minimum 10–15 years of post-graduate experience in mechanical infrastructure engineering.
Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, or working towards a recognized professional accreditation.
Proven experience in the design and delivery of LPG, Natural Gas (NG), and Synthetic Natural Gas (SNG) systems.
Strong experience in the design of gas pressure regulating stations (PPRS/SPRS) and gas distribution networks.
Extensive knowledge of district cooling systems, chilled water networks, and utility pump stations.
Demonstrated experience in utility master planning, feasibility studies, and infrastructure strategy development.
Proficiency in hydraulic modelling software such as Bentley WaterGEMS, SISHYD/GasWorks, FLUIDIT, or equivalent.
Strong understanding of ASHRAE, SBC, NFPA, IGEM, Civil Defense, Ministry of Energy, and other relevant local and international standards.
Experience in preparing technical reports, design calculations, specifications, tender documents, and authority approval submissions.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage complex infrastructure projects.
Experience coordinating with clients, contractors, utilities, and regulatory authorities.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical presentation skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Experience delivering infrastructure projects within Saudi Arabia and/or the GCC region is preferred.
Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

r: Lead the design and delivery of mechanical infrastructure projects with a focus on gas systems, district cooling/chilled water networks, and utility pump stations.
Provide technical leadership for engineering calculations, specifications, reports, drawings, and procurement support activities.
Develop feasibility studies and engineering assessments for cooling strategies, including district cooling and decentralized cooling systems at master planning stage.
Evaluate and recommend gas supply solutions, including LPG, Natural Gas (NG), and Synthetic Natural Gas (SNG), based on technical, commercial, and operational requirements.
Design gas storage facilities, gas farms, pressure regulating stations (PPRS/SPRS), and associated distribution networks for developments of varying scale.
Lead hydraulic modelling and network analysis for gas and chilled water systems using industry-standard software.
Prepare and review technical reports, design documentation, engineering specifications, and tender documents.
Develop district cooling plant concepts and performance specifications for Design & Build (D&B) projects.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure integrated and efficient infrastructure solutions.
Manage authority approvals and liaise with relevant stakeholders, including utility providers, Civil Defense, Ministry of Energy, district cooling operators, and municipal authorities.
Review contractor shop drawings, method statements, and material submittals to ensure compliance with project requirements.
Ensure all designs comply with applicable local regulations, international standards, safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.
Identify project risks and develop mitigation measures to support successful project delivery.
Support project planning, resource allocation, budgeting, and programme management activities.
Attend and lead technical meetings, client presentations, authority workshops, and design review sessions.
Mentor and develop junior engineers, providing technical guidance and supporting professional growth.
Maintain high standards of QA/QC throughout project execution and ensure quality deliverables are produced on time and within budget.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with teams across many countries working around the clock. Our products, markets, and regulations change fast, so how quickly our people learn is a real competitive advantage.

This is a new role. The Head of Learning & Development will build one learning engine for the whole company: how new hires get productive, how leaders grow, how engineers and sales teams stay sharp, and how the company comes together at all-hands.
Mission: Help every Bybit employee get up to speed fast, keep growing, and perform at their best, and build the leaders we need as we scale.

This position offers company-paid housing and transportation, a completion bonus and tuition reimbursement program!
